description.zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

- immediate：立即执行。
- scheduled：预约执行。
description.en:
O\&M task type. Valid values:

- immediate: Execute immediately.

- scheduled: Execute at a scheduled time.

description.zh: 预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。 当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输。
description.en: Scheduled execution time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This field is required when OpsType=scheduled.

descriptions.zh: - 此运维操作，目前仅支持事件类型：Instance:SystemFailure.Redeploy（因系统问题实例重新部署）、Instance:SystemMaintenance.Redeploy（因系统维护实例重新部署）
descriptions.en: - This O\&M operation currently supports only the following event types: Instance:SystemFailure.Redeploy (instance redeployment due to system failure) and Instance:SystemMaintenance.Redeploy (instance redeployment due to system maintenance).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens batch-event-redeploy-instance --event-infos ResourceId=i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l EventId=e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 PlanUtcTime=example-string OpsType=1742452232000 PlanTime=1 --region cn-hangzhou
